title: fix(plugin-detail): summary chip honours percentDisplay plain

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTRdLmK9YYgMSCJ7NH2PuUY)_
Fixes #36078

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 看记录页的用户:标题旁的摘要小标签里,百分比字段设成「只显示数字」时,以前仍画进度条,改后只显示百分数;其他情况不变。
- 为什么做:让记录页和列表对同一个百分比字段显示一致,解决胜率、利润率这类比率被误读成进度的问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是摘要小标签多画或少画一条进度条,数值文字不受影响,可直接撤回本次改动。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

The record header's `summaryFields` chip now honours a percent field's `percentDisplay` (the `percentDisplay` describe in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: `plain` = "the percentage as text alone, with no bar"). In `DetailView`'s chip percent arm, the bar's fill value is computed only when the merged field bag (view entry over object schema, the same `percentField` bag the arm already reads `scale` and `max` from) does not say `plain`; with `plain`, the chip falls through to the plain Badge branch, so the text (`formatPercent`, unchanged) and the accessible name (`Label: 40%`, unchanged) stay and only the bar goes. Because the arm is chosen by `armType`, a `formula` whose `returnType` is `percent` takes the same path and its own `percentDisplay` counts too.

The bar-or-not rule is the literal `percentDisplay === 'plain'` test, inline in `PercentCellRenderer` (`@object-ui/fields`) and not exported, so this is a local read of the one key, not a second copy of an exported helper and not a published-export change.

No `packages/spec` change. Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`, the hunk guarding `summaryChipPercentPoints` with `percentField.percentDisplay !== 'plain'`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/summaryChip.percentPlain-36078.test.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/summaryChip.percentPlain-36078.test.tsx` (spec, formula and client built) prints 7 passed.

## Tests

New `summaryChip.percentPlain-36078.test.tsx` (7 cases), stored value `0.4`:
- percent field `plain` reads `40%`, accessible name `Probability: 40%`, no bar track;
- percent formula (`returnType: 'percent'`) `plain`: same;
- `plain` declared on the object schema only (no view entry), judged after an arrival probe: same;
- CONTROL: percent field with no `percentDisplay`, and with `bar`, draws the bar filled to `40%`;
- CONTROL: percent formula with no `percentDisplay`, and with `bar`, draws the bar;
- CONTROL: a view entry `bar` over an object schema `plain` draws the bar (precedence).

- Directions on the base tree were predicted before the first run and the ablation matched them: the three `plain` cases red, the four controls green.
- Overlap: `overlap-check.mjs` names open PR #36234 as sharing `DetailView.tsx`; it merges cleanly with this branch.
- No out-of-scope findings.
